cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Pick the Prize
cards.instruction: Make them choose which reward, principle, or relationship matters most when not everything can be kept.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's handle this professionally. Choose the trophy ceremony or our anniversary dinner. They're at the same time.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can explain the standard again. Slowly. Then you're choosing the trophy and postponing us. Say which.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It could be a short ceremony.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Will you leave before your name is called? That's the choice.
